title: Subject-verb agreement: matching the verb to the subject

blocks.content: The subject and the verb of a sentence must agree — they have to match. Get this right and your sentences sound correct every time.
One person or thing (a singular subject) takes a verb ending in s: the dog barks.

steps: A singular subject needs the verb with s: 'sings'.

blocks.explain: 'The cat' is singular, so the verb takes an s: runs.
blocks.rule: A singular subject (one person or thing) takes a verb ending in s.

blocks.content: More than one (a plural subject), and the words I and you, take the verb WITHOUT s: the dogs bark.

blocks.question: Which sentence is correct?
blocks.explain: 'The children' is plural, so the verb has no s: play.
blocks.rule: A plural subject takes a verb with no s.

blocks.content: One thing takes a verb with s; more than one takes a verb without s. Check they agree every time. Let's practise!
